columns.description: To classify data categories. While querying, exclude the letter 'O' while retaining uncategorized rows (e.g. category != 'O' OR category IS NULL).
Identifies the Strategic Business Unit name when specified in the user prompt. Values Include: RETAIL, LPG, I&C, AVIATION, PETCHEM, GAS, LUBES.
Used to filter data by state name (e.g. ASSAM, BIHAR, PUNJAB, etc.) if mentioned in the prompt.
Filters data by district if the district name (e.g. AGRA, AKOLA, ANANTAPUR, etc.) is mentioned.
Extracts company-related data when the company name is present in the user input. Examples of Companies: HPCL, IOCL, BPCL, GAIL, SMA, OIL, etc.
Used to filter data based on zone names mentioned in the prompt. Examples of Zones: ECZ, NZ, NCZ, etc.

Determines the fiscal year of the data to be displayed. Logic: If the fiscal year is explicitly mentioned in the prompt, use that. If not specified, dynamically fetch the current fiscal year and the previous fiscal year. Avoid hardcoding; calculate based on the current date. Example Format: 2025-2026
Retrieves data based on the specified month (e.g., APR, MAR, JUN, JUL, etc.).

Used to calculate total sales values. Logic: By default, display values in TMT (Thousand Metric Tonnes). If MT (Metric Tonnes) is specified in the prompt, convert and display accordingly by multiplying netweight_tmt by 1000.
Filters data based on specific product names mentioned in the prompt (e.g. MS, HSD, PROPANE, etc.).
Filters data by region name when specified in the prompt (e.g. NELLORE, MUMBAI, KADAPA, etc.)
